sql: WITH ours AS ( SELECT DISTINCT p.ndc11, p.spl_set_id, p.labeler_name, lower(p.generic_name) AS molecule FROM (SELECT ndc11 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION SELECT ndc11 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION SELECT ndc11 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11), plants AS ( SELECT DISTINCT o.labeler_name, o.molecule, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM ours o JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = o.spl_set_id JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE st.fei IS NOT NULL AND st.fei <> ''), latest AS ( SELECT fei, classification, end_date FROM ( SELECT fei, classification, end_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY fei ORDER BY end_date DESC) AS rn FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN (SELECT fei FROM plants)) t WHERE rn = 1), acts AS ( SELECT fei, count(*) AS n FROM ( SELECT fei FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE classification = 'OAI' AND end_date >= '2023-10-21' AND fei IN (SELECT fei FROM plants) UNION ALL SELECT fei FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE action_date >= '2023-10-21' AND fei IN (SELECT fei FROM plants) UNION ALL SELECT fei FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE date_published >= '2023-10-21' AND fei IN (SELECT fei FROM plants)) a GROUP BY fei) SELECT p.fei, p.firm_name, p.country_iso3, p.address, p.labeler_name, p.molecule, l.classification AS last_class, l.end_date AS last_date, coalesce(a.n, 0) AS signals FROM plants p LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.fei = p.fei LEFT JOIN acts a ON a.fei = p.fei
